{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Black wool-blend blazer, tailored fit with sharp shoulders, charcoal grey (#3C424A), structured woven fabric.
White silk-poplin blouse, relaxed collar and button-front closure, pure white (#FFFFFF), smooth fluid silk.
High-waisted wide-leg trousers in dark denim, straight cut with a clean hem, blackwash (#0B1015), heavyweight rigid cotton.
Chunky leather ankle boots, pointed toe, matte black finish (#1A1A1A), polished calfskin leather.
This outfit honors your request for something restrained and classic by anchoring the rock concert atmosphere in tailored suiting and dark denim rather than loud graphics or distressed textures. The monochromatic palette of charcoal, white, and deep black creates a timeless silhouette that allows the stage lighting to be the only source of visual noise. By choosing structured pieces with clean lines, you will stand confidently in the crowd while maintaining an elegant, understated look that transcends fleeting fashion trends."}
